taxonomy.basis: MPI-5.0 release-vault chapter API transclusions and heading paths; final PDF binding summary and explicit legacy mappings supply fallbacks
taxonomy.note: Kind, family and variant are atlas storage keys, not MPI-defined taxonomy terms. Operation form is distinct from procedure blocking semantics. Sections use standard titles; orthogonal facets remain separate.
taxonomy.vault_note: Exact chapter and heading paths were read from the MPI-5.0 release vault, with the final PDF binding summary as fallback for appendix-only and legacy entries.

standard_audit.scope: Catalogue C-binding coverage and metadata; no runtime implementation conformance tests.
limitations: Vaults are derived renderings, not normative publications.
MPI-1.0/1.1 are absent; MPI-1.3 cannot distinguish introductions in 1.0 and 1.2.
MPI-2.0 is an extensions volume, not a complete cumulative API inventory.
Callbacks may appear in prose before their signatures enter the appendices.
MPI_op_free is a known historical spelling inconsistency, not a missing atlas API.
A complete name inventory does not establish implementation semantic conformance.
